record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, multiply each Transformer feed-forward residual contribution by 0.5, leaving attention residuals unchanged. This may preserve contextual attention signals while limiting feed-forward distortion on short histories, providing a smaller architectural intervention than the regressed GEGLU replacement. Retain existing GELU sublayers, dimensions, normalization, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer; use identical residual scaling in training and prediction.
